title: Reed in one line
description: A continuous heron emblem draws in oxblood ink across saffron stock, leaving a quiet printed impression underneath.
useCase: Reveal an authored identity, illustration or sign-off through the order of its pen stroke.
reducedMotion: Replay shows the complete emblem immediately; host pause freezes an in-progress stroke and resumes from that position.
limitations: An independently authored stylized bird identity with a fixed path, not handwriting recognition, a captured human signature or a drawing input. The paper impression and shadows are authored CSS/SVG treatments.
look: Tilted saffron paper square on a vermilion-red field, with a fine oxblood single-line heron illustration, a faint offset impression and a large lowercase serif wordmark.
motion: The emblem starts complete; pressing replay redraws it as one stroke via stroke-dashoffset over 2.1 s ease-in-out, and the eye dot appears about a quarter through.
adapt: Drawing is `@keyframes sd-heron-ink`, animating `stroke-dashoffset` from 100 on the `.sd-ink` path (`pathLength` 100), re-triggered by bumping `key={run}`. Swap `heron` for your path, keep `pathLength`, and tune `2100ms cubic-bezier(.37,.12,.28,1)`; replace the wordmark.
